newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-KIPKETER WINS SECOND WORLD 800 METRES GOLD.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-KIPKETER WINS SECOND WORLD 800 METRES GOLD.

text.p: Wilson Kipketer of Denmark missed out on a world record but still easily retained his world 800 metres title with an assured victory in one minute 43.38 seconds on Friday.

Kipketer blasted through the first 200 in a speedy 23.47 seconds and clocked 49.68 for the first lap but although his victory was never in doubt he could not threaten the record of 1:41.73 which he shares with Briton Seb Coe.

Norberto Tellez of Cuba took the silver in 1:44.00 with American Rich Kenah running a lifetime best of 1:44.25 to take the bronze. Norwegian Olympic champion Vebjoern Rodal was never in contention and finished fifth.
Kenyan-born Kipketer missed out on the Atlanta Olympics last year because of a wrangle between the Kenyan federation and his adopted Denmark.
